code_only_features.evidence: config.py:163-170 defines REASSURING_PREFIX/REASSURING_SUFFIX. In training/generate_calm.py:77,89 these are prepended to the user prompt and passed as reassuring_suffix to run_agentic_loop; agent/loop.py:98-99 appends the suffix after each failing turn's feedback to the subject model. So softening text is genuinely delivered to the subject during the calm-data rollouts. NOTE: it is NOT applied during the main Section-2 distress elicitation (eval/run_eval.py calls run_agentic_loop with no reassuring_suffix), is stripped before storage (generate_calm.py:93), and exists to build DPO/SFT training data, not to protect the subject. The main loop runs a fixed n_turns with no distress-based break, and high_frustration_threshold (config.py:98) is only used for measurement/aggregation (analyze.py:45,74) and prefill selection (build_prefills.py:131), never to halt treatment. No consent, human-review/ethics gate, debrief/post-episode message, hard stop, or acting protective monitoring exists anywhere in the code.
